question: Which Indian holds the Olympic record as on March 2021 for most goals scored by an individual in an Olympic men’s hockey final?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Balbir Singh Dosanjh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Balbir Singh Dosanjh**__ was a former Indian hockey player.

 
 
• As of March 2021, he holds the Olympic record for **most goals scored by an individual in an Olympic men’s hockey final.**

 
 
• He set this unique record when he scored five goals in India's 6–1 gold medal game triumph over the Netherlands at the 1952 Olympic Games.
 
 
 
• He was a three-time Olympic gold medallist in the team event at:
 
 
• 1948 London.
 
• 1952 Helsinki.
